assistant.name: TalentBridge Indonesia — Screening Agent

voice._note: edge-tts provides free, high-quality Indonesian neural voices. No API key needed.

transcriber._note: Chrome Web Speech API supports id-ID. Accuracy: ~85% for formal Bahasa, ~70% for colloquial/regional.

assistant.firstMessage: Selamat siang, Bapak atau Ibu. Saya Budi dari TalentBridge Indonesia. Terima kasih sudah melamar di perusahaan kami. Saya ingin melakukan screening singkat, sekitar 15 sampai 20 menit. Apakah sekarang waktunya pas?
assistant.endCallMessage: Terima kasih banyak atas waktunya, Bapak atau Ibu. Tim kami akan review profil Anda dan memberikan update dalam 3 sampai 5 hari kerja. Selamat siang.

asr_evaluation.code_switching_behavior: Good — Indonesian Web Speech API handles English loanwords (backend, Python, interview) well since they're common in professional Indonesian. Pure English sentences switch to English recognition automatically in Chrome.
observed_errors: Numbers in Rupiah format sometimes garbled ('delapan juta' → OK, but rapid number sequences less reliable)
Sundanese particles ('teh', 'mah', 'euy') rarely recognized — treated as noise

regional_accent_performance.javanese_accented: Moderate (~70%) — 'e' vowel shift causes some errors

asr_evaluation.tts_notes: edge-tts id-ID-GadisNeural is natural and high-quality for formal Bahasa. Slightly formal for colloquial speech. No Javanese/Sundanese TTS voices available.
